page.layout: Running head at top, with page number at top right. Below it one column of entries: each entry is a numbered heading with a Roman numeral in the right column, followed by its reference lines in italic beneath.; One column of index entries, with topic headings and italic chapter and verse references, and at the right margin the running note "Loci politi-ci in Proverbiis Solomonis." with roman numerals I to IV beside the first four topics.

main_text.head: LOCI POLITICI.Loci politi-ci in Proverbiis Solomonis.

page.notes: The numerals in the right column and the reference lines are italic in the scan; the headings are in roman small capitals. "c.3o." in the reference line of 21 is read as "c.30." and "v.8.3." as printed. The printed page carries no page number or running head. The marginal title and the numerals I to IV are printed in the right margin and are given as notes beside the entries they stand next to.
